open_points.subject: register_work_payment
open_points.text: register_work_payment: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through insert_work_payment of the project_tracking repository of that transaction, a ProjectTrackingRepository.
open_points.other_text: register_work_payment: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST call get_work_payment of the ProjectTrackingRepository the project_tracking accessor of that transaction returns, with exactly payment_id, never project_id plus payment_id; it MUST verify an existing payment belongs to the project_id of the context before replay classification.
open_points.question: Must the required payment read use get_work_payment, or must it go through insert_work_payment?

open_points.subject: register_work_payment
open_points.text: register_work_payment: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through insert_work_payment of the project_tracking repository of that transaction, a ProjectTrackingRepository.
open_points.question: The insert_work_payment contract only accepts a WorkPayment for insertion and returns None; the note must limit it to the payment write instead of requiring reads through it.

open_points.subject: register_work_payment
open_points.text: register_work_payment: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through insert_work_payment of the project_tracking repository of that transaction, a ProjectTrackingRepository.
open_points.other_text: register_work_payment: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST perform all WorkPayment reads/writes through the ProjectTrackingRepository the project_tracking accessor of that transaction returns, pass the audit repository of that transaction to append_audit with reason_code None for success, and commit both writes once; any failure MUST rollback both repositories on the shared transaction.
open_points.question: Must the audit write use append_audit with the audit repository, or must every write go through insert_work_payment?

open_points.subject: set_section_progress
open_points.text: set_section_progress: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through upsert_section_progress of the project_tracking repository of that transaction, a ProjectTrackingRepository.
open_points.other_text: set_section_progress: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open one transaction by beginning a transaction with begin of the store, which returns a PortalTransaction, only after validate_project_section has completed; it MUST perform all SectionProgress reads/writes through the ProjectTrackingRepository the project_tracking accessor of that transaction returns, pass the audit repository of that transaction to append_audit with reason_code None for success, and commit both writes once; any failure after that transaction is opened MUST rollback both repositories on the shared transaction.
open_points.question: Must the audit write use append_audit with the audit repository, or must every write go through upsert_section_progress?
